name: BSP_HudSceneInitScreen_Register

name: BSP_HudMarker_ProjectAndClip
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX=const float3* world, EDX=float3* outScreen) -> bool, RET (no stack args), body 00638E50..00638F41. Calls BSP_Camera_ProjectWorldToScreen(world,out,1,0); fully=((flags&7)==7). When [0109CF04+0Dh] is set it first rescales x about 0.5 by 00CF5750 (4/3) and, only when not fully visible, requires (flags&6)==6 and 00E197D0<x<00E197CC; when the byte is clear it requires fully and 00E197D8<x<00E197D4. Both paths then require 00E197C8<y<00E197C4. The two x pairs hold the same values, so 00E197C4..00E197D8 is one clip rectangle with duplicated x bounds, not two rectangles. Callers 005224C0, 006395E0, 0063A6C0, 00640A20, 00640D70, 00641910, 00642040, 00642C20, 00643360, 006434E0. docs/HUD_MARKERS_RUNTIME.md.

name: BSP_InGameHudMarkers_ResolveMarkerColourIndex
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(UnitInstance* unit) -> int, body 00639990..? Returns 5 by default, 1 when [unit+54h]==0 and 0 when [unit+54h]==1. When 00803CE0 returns 1 and 008DDF90 finds the unit in the objective container it instead maps 008DD240(unit)[18h] 0,1,3,4 to 2,3,4 and so on. name: BSP_HudMarker_ProjectUnitScreenBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this=markers screen 4Dh, float3 anchorWorld by value, UnitInstance* unit, char* outCollapsed, float* outMinX, float* outMinY, float* outMaxX, float* outMaxY), RET 24h, body 0063A6C0..0063ABCD. Seeds the bounds with 00CE4970 (1e10) and 00CE4ADC (-1e10) and clears outCollapsed. Refreshes the pose (00414DB0), reads the world matrix rows at unit+DCh (up) and unit+ECh (forward), and for IsKindOf(6) without IsKindOf(8) raises the anchor by unit[538h][A8h] along up and doubles the up row (00D7A308). Then a triple loop over i,j,k in {-1,+1} builds eight corners anchor +- 0.5*[538h+A4h]*row0 +- 0.5*[538h+A8h]*row1 +- 0.5*[538h+A0h]*row2, projects each with 00638E50 and accumulates min/max of the screen x and y. A box narrower than this[88h]/1.5 is widened about its centre by 00CEC9E0 (-0.5); the y test uses the same margin scaled by 00CF5780 (1.33). When both axes were widened it reprojects the anchor alone, collapses all four bounds to that point and sets outCollapsed. Callers 00641910, 00642040, 00642C20. docs/HUD_MARKERS_RUNTIME.md.

name: BSP_HudMarker_WriteUnitMarkerWidgets
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this=markers screen 4Dh, ...), body 0063D1E0..0063DEBD, SEH handler 00C7A010. Hides the screen widget slots at this+68h, +6Ch, +70h, +74h, +78h, +7Ch and +80h, then binds and drives the per-marker children by name: Unit_name_Text (00CF58CC, Resize 0Eh), Distance_Text (00CF58BC, 0Dh), HP_Icon (00CF58B4, 7), HP_BG_Icon (00CF58A8, 0Ah), type_Icon (00CF57B4, 9) and commandbuilding_Icon (00CF5818, 14h). Positions go through BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalPositionAndBounds and BSP_GuiWidget_SetResolvedPosition, label text through BSP_GuiText_SetLocalisedSource and BSP_GuiText_SetLocalisedCString, sizes through BSP_GuiWidget_GetSize.
